messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — I sketched a consolidation plan to move the old API key surface to the new auth stack. Key idea: embed claims `org`, `project`, `sa` and a `rate_band` into short-lived proxy tokens issued by the auth proxy.
Ajay Patel: Nice. Does `rate_band` map to quota groups we already have?
Maria Chen: Yes — rate_band would be a conservative mapping to existing quota tiers (free/dev/prod). The proxy will translate into quota key used by the rate limiter.
Kevin O'Leary: Concern: how do we prevent service-account impersonation if the proxy issues claims for `sa`?
Maria Chen: We keep the canonical mapping in the backend KV + signed attestation. Proxy issues tokens only after verifying ownership via key rotation or signed cert. No freeform `sa` RSVPs.
Sam Rivera: Punting a bit to telemetry: we need to capture both original API key id and the proxied token id in traces. Otherwise billing and alerts get fuzzy.
Maria Chen: Agreed — plan: add two fields to request meta `original_key_id` and `proxy_token_id`. These flow into traces/metrics and to billing pipeline.
Ajay Patel: Will that break existing dashboards? We should keep backward compatibility for per-org dashboards.
Maria Chen: Dashboard aggregation will default to `original_key_id -> org` mapping for the rollout window. We'll add a flag in the console to flip to `proxy_token` view post-rollout.
Kevin O'Leary: Rollout strategy? Canary a small percentage of requests to go through proxy-first path?
Maria Chen: Yes: 1) opt-in beta via console (project-level toggle), 2) 5% traffic canary routed by smart-router, 3) 25% and up after telemetry sanity checks.
Sam Rivera: UX request: key rotation flow should show a diff: which services will be impacted by the new proxy claim mapping. Also a one-click rollback.
Maria Chen: Good call. Console will surface a preflight check (simulated requests) and a rollback button that disables proxy tokens for that project.
Ajay Patel: Security note — ensure KMS/HSM signing keys used by proxy are tenant-scoped or we risk cross-tenant signing.
Maria Chen: Yes, proxy uses per-tenant signing keys stored in KMS namespaces; fallback to org-level only for older tenants with a migration flag.
Kevin O'Leary: How about rate limiting enforcement when a proxy token is stale/rotated mid-request? Need graceful fallback to original key-level limits.
Maria Chen: Runtime must check token validity; if token unknown, fallback to original key id and emit a `proxy_miss` tag in telemetry. We'll circuit-break after repeated misses.
Sam Rivera: Tests to add: 1) impersonation attempt simulated, 2) telemetry mapping correctness, 3) canary rollback behavior.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: auth-proxy:v3 -> staging. Triggered by maria.
Ajay Patel: Let's schedule an eng-platform sync Thurs 10am to finalise config schema and console screens.
Maria Chen: Thanks — I'll drop the RFC and a short migration checklist into the eng-platform folder after the meeting. :+1:
